title: multipart: add OpenAI-compat file input handling, content-type validation, and payload limits
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR implements multipart/form-data file input support for the OpenAI compatibility layer, adds content-type validation and configurable per-file and total payload limits, and improves streaming stability when files are passed alongside streaming chat/generation requests. Motivation: customers expect the OpenAI-compatible /files and model input semantics while using Redwood's streaming and function-calling features. This patch ensures we accept typical client payloads (multipart with both JSON parts and file parts), enforce safe limits by default, and reject unsupported content types early to avoid runtime failures. Changes include: 1) new multipart parser that supports mixed JSON and file parts and normalizes into the internal FileInput model; 2) content-type allowlist for uploaded files (configurable per deployment) and stronger validation error messages returned as OpenAI-compat style errors; 3) per-file size and combined payload limits with clear headers (X-File-Size, X-Total-Upload-Bytes) surfaceable in responses and logs; 4) updates to streaming codepath so file uploads are buffered and validated before streaming tokens begin to avoid mid-stream aborts; 5) tests, docs, and a small migration note for downstream SDKs. Checklist: - add multipart parser and unit tests; - wire validation into openai-compat handler; - expose limits in config and Redwood Console; - update Python/TS SDK examples in examples repo; - add integration test that covers streaming + file inputs. Related: ENG-4121 (file upload limits), ENG-4189 (streaming stability), SUP-237 (customer bug report).

review_comments: Liam Patel (2026-02-21): Please document the default limits in the code and ensure they are overridable via env/config. Also add a note about behaviour when a file exceeds the per-file limit (400 vs 413 semantics).

Ava Chen (2026-02-21): Default limits are documented in internal/config/filelimits.go and exposed in Console. We return 413 Payload Too Large for per-file violations and 400 Bad Request with a structured OpenAI-style error for combined payload violations. Added tests.
Sofia Martinez (2026-02-22): The content-type allowlist looks good. Suggest we log the rejected mime type at warn level and include the allowlist name in the error message for easier debugging.
Ava Chen (2026-02-22): Added warning log when rejecting a mime type and enhanced error message to include allowlist name. See updated tests for log assertion.

Ethan Ross (2026-02-23): Integration test flaky on CI due to a timing window where streaming starts before validation finishes in CI under heavy load. Can we add a backoff/retry or ensure validation completes synchronously before streaming begins?

Ava Chen (2026-02-23): Fixed by making validation synchronous for multipart requests that include files; added a resilience path that streams a small preamble only after validation passes. Marked the flaky test stable and added retries in CI config for the integration suite.
Liam Patel (2026-02-23): CI failure in lint step on a helper name; addressed in follow-up commit. Approving once CI is green.
